newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: NYMEX pares losses after U.S. refinery fire.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX pares losses after U.S. refinery fire.

text.p: Crude futures prices on NYMEX pared some losses in Asia on Wednesday after news of a fire breaking out at Tosco Corp's 150,000 barrels per day Avon refinery in California.
The March contract, trading on the after-hours ACCESS system, was last traded at $24.18 per barrel, down four cents from New York's close and four cents higher than before the news.
However, just a handful of lots were exchanged after news of the fire broke, traders said. ACCESS products were untraded since the fire news.
A Tosco spokesman said a fire broke out at the refinery after an explosion in a hydrocracker. There were no injuries.
The spokesman said it was too early to say if the fire would disrupt operations.
March Brent, trading on SIMEX, was last traded at $22.32, down from midday's $22.35 and off four cents from London.
